# Dubai Real Estate Directory

> An independent, curated directory of 24 established real estate agencies and brokerages in Dubai, UAE.

Dubai Real Estate Directory helps buyers, sellers, renters and investors compare trusted real estate agencies across Dubai by area, specialty and service type. All agencies are independently curated — listing placement is never sold or reordered by payment. Featured badges are paid placements and are clearly labelled as such.

## Directory

- [Betterhomes](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/betterhomes): One of Dubai's oldest agencies since 1986. Residential sales, leasing, commercial, property management, holiday homes.
- [Allsopp & Allsopp](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/allsopp-allsopp): UK-founded agency focused on residential sales and lettings across Dubai.
- [haus & haus](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/haus-haus): Dubai-based residential specialists with strong off-plan and secondary market coverage.
- [Driven Properties](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/driven-properties): Luxury residential and commercial brokerage covering prime Dubai areas.
- [AX Capital](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/ax-capital): Residential sales and leasing with focus on new developments and luxury.
- [Espace Real Estate](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/espace-real-estate): Independent brokerage specialising in Dubai Springs, Meadows, Lakes and Emirates Living.
- [Metropolitan Premium Properties](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/metropolitan-premium-properties): Russian-founded agency with broad UAE portfolio covering residential and commercial.
- [Provident Estate](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/provident-estate): Dubai-based agency covering off-plan, secondary market, and property management.
- [D&B Properties](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/db-properties): Residential sales and leasing across Dubai with off-plan specialisation.
- [Exclusive Links Real Estate Brokers](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/exclusive-links-real-estate-brokers): Established brokerage covering residential and commercial across Dubai.
- [Aeon & Trisl](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/aeon-trisl): Full-service brokerage covering sales, leasing and property management.
- [Xperience Realty](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/xperience-realty): Property agency offering residential sales, leasing and management services.
- [Engel & Völkers Dubai](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/engel-volkers-dubai): German luxury real estate brand with Dubai residential and commercial coverage.
- [Knight Frank UAE](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/knight-frank-uae): Global property consultancy with UAE residential, commercial and investment advisory.
- [Savills Dubai](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/savills-dubai): Global property brand covering Dubai residential, commercial and investment.
- [Bluechip Real Estate](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/bluechip-real-estate): Property agency covering Dubai residential sales and leasing.
- [Profound Properties](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/profound-properties): Dubai brokerage focused on residential and off-plan property.
- [Think Realty](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/think-realty): Property agency offering sales, leasing and comprehensive property management.
- [McCone Properties](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/mccone-properties): Boutique Dubai brokerage with residential sales and leasing focus.
- [fäm Properties](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/fam-properties): One of Dubai's largest brokerages by volume, covering residential and commercial.
- [Unique Properties](https://dubairealestatedirectory.com/agencies/unique-properties): Dubai-based agency covering residential sales, leasing and investment.

## About This Directory

- **Independence**: No agency pays to be listed in the standard directory. No listing is reordered by payment.
- **Featured Placements**: Clearly labelled paid positions for agencies that choose to upgrade their profile.
- **Star Ratings**: Each agency's star rating is its public Google Maps rating, checked by hand weekly.
- **Coverage**: All agencies listed operate in Dubai, UAE. Areas covered include Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, JVC, Arabian Ranches, Dubai Hills Estate, JBR, DIFC and more.
- **Contact**: hello@dubairealestatedirectory.com
